e: For its composition of niobium, and Ancient Greek φύλλον (phúllon, “leaf”) for its foliated crystal habit, + -ite.
Named for its composition of (NIO)bium and (CAL)cium, + -ite.
From Niobe + -ium, because of the element's affinity with tantalum, named after Niobe's father Tantalus.
q: One should use hypoallergenic jewelry made of surgical grade stainless steel, titanium, 14- or 18-karat gold, or niobium, especially for initial piercings.
